title: Sejmik storey merged into v1.2 (plan, gallery sightlines); exterior frames approved, finals started
stages: Site ✔ (zoning, heritage, survey, geotech, trees, neighbours)
Design research ✔ (trends, visuals, boards, façades, costs)
Concept v1.1 ✔ + Sejmik storey S-3 ✔ → merge into v1.2 with stair-A fix and cost check (workflow ►)
Production ►: drawings v1.1 ✔ (verified); plans + tables re-run after v1.2; photomatch W1/W2 tests ✔; extra showcase renders (workflow ►)
Boards & texts ►: Stage II 8/8 skeletons (vis pending, P7/P8 re-layout); Stage II text 5 × A3 + Stage I text + F.14.A (workflow ►); 300-dpi export ✔
Audit ►: completeness 25/44; structural & functional audit ►; jury later
notes: Sejmik storey S-3 merged into spec v1.2 (verification in progress): chamber 232 m² with 47 desks in 4 curved rows (43 + 4 wheelchair, 5 % ramps), presidium against the full wall; councillors' upper hall and public gallery on the +30.90 mezzanine with separate routes; stair A now 21 risers with a 1.50 m landing.
Gallery sightlines checked in section: both gallery rows see the presidium, the speaker and the chair over the 1.10 m glass.

Exterior frames W1–W5 approved; finals running in order W5 → W4 → W3 → W1/W2 (≈ 4.5–6 h at 4 000–8 000 px). Hall W6 on hold: the 3D agent found the diagonal hall axis narrows to 3.9 m in the plan (claimed 6.3 m); fix routed to the plans re-run.
